why: rc11: NPC names, full map zone names, share codes, 940 marked names in quests

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc11 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

New: NPC names (tooltip, nameplates, target frame) in Persian / Persian with English under it / English, set in the new NPC page.
New: every zone name written on the world map (not just the two big continents) is translated, following the map option.
New: Share page: copy your whole custom setup as a code, or paste somebody else's code to use it.
Data: 940 more NPC and zone names are now marked inside quest texts, so the colours pick them up.

Includes rc7 to rc10.

Data from ForeverDB.net
